title: A small fix skips both gates
context: Split out of ADR-0045. ADR-0051 later drew where the line falls for fixes that touch decision records.
decision: A fix that only restores documented behaviour, or changes no behaviour, skips both gates and the Change page store and goes straight to a pull request under the Fix path. Its commits carry a Refs trailer when the fix came from a tracker issue, and the pull request is its only gate.
consequences: A Fix-path change has no Proposal or Review page and no publish step.
